parsed.title: Chat summary of AI, bus anecdotes, weather, diploma covers, and PC case hack

claims.text: AI models are not inherently intelligent; their complex abilities come from toolkits, ready-made examples, and external runtimes.
InstinctGPT comparison shows that a 3B model with tools can outperform a 175B model on some tasks, but toolkits cannot fully compensate for missing core model abilities.
Older models were trained on everything without clear objectives, whereas modern models aim to achieve more with fewer effective parameters and are sometimes fine‑tuned for specific tasks.
P1 recounts sitting in a bus alone and observing weird people, including a repeated encounter where someone “газу навалює”.
Further bizarre behavior is described: the person first played piano loudly, then listened to metro announcements, then made micro‑sounds to a mother before the shower.
A part of the city is under clouds.
There is a feeling of an impending rain that feels like lava due to the temperature.
Some participants report being asked to pay for diploma covers: 650 UAH (from Богдан), 30 UAH (another source), and 47 UAH (another participant).
Opinions expressed that covers are unnecessary waste: they are just paper, no one will keep them, and they are only looked at three times (receiving, photographing, later translation).

claims.text: A small PC case originally fits only one small video card, but with straps and force it can accommodate three cards.
